PagerDuty Bot: HIGH: gpu-pool 'inference-prod-a' queue length > 1200, eviction throttles firing, 50% pod OOMs, paging oncall. https://pager.example/INC-5123
Carlos (oncall-ml): seeing a flood of requests and long queueing in the autoscaler metrics. autoscaler attempts but nodes go into NotReady after Xid/oom spikes. paging Erin.
Erin (sre): on it — mounting dashboards. initial hypothesis: recent nvidia-driver 525.x rollout to pool? @Raj any rollout today?
Raj (infra): we did a staged driver update to that pool ~2h ago (kernel module 525.89). Rollout status: 80% complete. No rollback yet.
Maya (runtime): runtime logs show recurring CUDA Xid 31/79 bursts and async mem faults. Also KV cache thrashing causing long scheduling windows. excerpt: ```2026-11-03T14:12:03Z runtime INFO gpu-0: Xid 79, process inference-worker, gpu-mem-exhausted
2026-11-03T14:12:04Z runtime WARN scheduling: backlog window=12s queue=1300```
Carlos (oncall-ml): customers hitting 503s and elevated error rates. Support reporting increased latency for embeddings and chat routes. Lucy, can you confirm impacted customers?
Support - Lucy: Confirmed: acme-corp and travelly-prod have elevated 5xx and timeouts across multiple endpoints. Priority P1 customer (acme) is seeing 40% error rate. notifying CSM.
Erin (sre): Temp mitigation plan: 1) Stop driver rollout to remaining nodes 2) Drain most affected nodes from the pool 3) Add capacity via warm spare pool if autoscaler is hitting upper cap 4) Revert to previous driver on a small set for verification.
Raj (infra): stopping rollout now. patch coordinator: canceled remaining batches. Trying to uncordon two rollback-capable nodes for driver rollback.
DeployBot: Driver rollout canceled by Raj at 2465012389.
Maya (runtime): important: when node flaps, runtime doesn't clear KV caches fast enough; that causes duplicate warmups and transient OOMs. will instrument an emergency kv-cache TTL reduction to 30s. can push a config change to runtime via feature-flag.
Carlos (oncall-ml): Go ahead with the KV TTL change, Maya. Also do a small canary revert of driver on 2 nodes. We'll observe error-rate.
Maya (runtime): issuing config change: ```curl -XPOST https://controlplane/api/v1/runtime/config -d '{"kv_ttl_s":30}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***'```
Maya (runtime): config applied to prod-controlplane. Propagating.
Erin (sre): draining ack: `kubectl drain node-gpu-17 -n inference --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` -> started.
Carlos (oncall-ml): autoscaler logs show "reached max_pool_nodes: 120" at 2465012405. We are hitting configured upper bound. Need short term capacity increase. Raj can you raise pool cap?
Raj (infra): raising max_pool_nodes to 160 now. patching autoscaler config: `helm upgrade autoscaler -f overrides.yaml` -> applied.
Raj (infra): note: cloud account has soft quota, requested emergency quota bump from cloud team — approval pending but cluster-level cap change applied.
Support - Lucy: I'll update acme with preliminary mitigation note: we have active engineering mitigation; working on capacity + rollback. ETA unknown.
Maya (runtime): small revert completed on node-gpu-17 and node-gpu-22. Observed drop in Xid spikes on those nodes within 30s. partial improvement in queue drain rate.
Erin (sre): good sign. continuing to drain 6 worst nodes to prevent repeated flaps. Monitoring memory+Xid counters.
PagerDuty Bot: Reminder: Pager escalation to level-2 if customers still >30% error after 15m.
Carlos (oncall-ml): handoff to Erin for the next 2 hours while I coordinate with product/CS. tagging @Erin as incident lead.
Erin (sre): I'm the incident lead. Next steps: 1) finish drain of 6/8 nodes 2) validate autoscaler cap increase is effective 3) monitor queue length and tail latency 4) plan rollback of driver for remaining nodes if regressions persist.
Maya (runtime): queued a hotfix to reduce KV cache TTL and limit concurrent warmups per-model to 2. Patch ID: runtime-hotfix-2026-11-03-1. Deploy in 2m.
Maya (runtime): hotfix deployed, rollout 20% -> 100% over 3 mins. logs: `warmup_concurrency=2` applied.
Carlos (oncall-ml): queue length trend: 1300 -> 700 over 10m after hotfix and drain. still high but trending down.
Support - Lucy: update sent to customers: "We've implemented mitigations (driver rollback canaries, runtime hotfix, capacity increase). We're monitoring; next update in 30m or as status changes."
Raj (infra): cloud quota approved for emergency bump; autoscaler now reporting capacity ready additional 40 nodes. nodes joining pool.
Maya (runtime): observed a secondary issue: some older model shards still try to allocate large pinned allocations leading to OOM. applying model-launch caps as temporary measure.
Erin (sre): set model launch concurrent cap to 1 for older shards. `kubectl patch configmap inference-limits -n prod --patch '{"data":{"old_shard_concurrency":"1"}}'`
Carlos (oncall-ml): error rate for acme dropped from 42% to 12% in last 12m. Good progress. keep monitoring.
PagerDuty Bot: LEVEL-1: incidents ongoing; PAGER silence set for non-paging notifications.
DeployBot: driver rollback on canary nodes completed by Raj at 2465012550.
Maya (runtime): on nodes with rollback we see stabilized GPU memory allocations, Xid events stop. On nodes still with 525 driver, Xid noise continues but reduced after KV TTL + concurrency limits.
Erin (sre): action items: - continue draining and reprovisioning until pool healthy - run memory leak check on runtime allocator - schedule a coordinated driver rollback window with infra + runtime team tomorrow.
Support - Lucy: customers notified of improvement. leaving incident channel open for 2hr post-stable.
Carlos (oncall-ml): handing follow-ups to Erin. I'm stepping off incident. thanks all. :thumbsup:
Erin (sre): closing loop in 1h. If queue < 200 and errorRate < 2% we'll mark as resolved. current metrics: queue=180, errorRate=1.8% at 2465012610.
